title: Märchen-Almanach auf das Jahr 1826
summary: "Märchen-Almanach auf das Jahr 1826" by Wilhelm Hauff is a collection of fairy tales published in 1825. A mysterious traveler joins a merchant caravan crossing the desert, suggesting they share stories to pass the time.
